decision.reason: All 120 bitpacks and 1200 rows independently reproduce, and the D3 choice is a static 13-of-16 weight-fit predicate rather than a runtime oracle. The positive selective point remains an optimistic ledger with only 1.214x joint fairness sensitivity and collapses to 0.574x if usable cache capacity falls from 13 to 12 entries, so only a new fail-closed CPU contract is justified.

full_pidp.scope: optimistic deterministic CPU fast-kill coordinate, not measured physical slowdown or paper speedup

p1.title: The selective positive is a fragile optimistic composition, not executable cycle evidence
p1.evidence: Canonical 1.474346x gives PIDP 10 cycles/group versus A1 15 and changes semantic source access from the inherited one-bit scanner to 128-bit words. Equalizing either axis leaves 1.265x/1.431x; equalizing both leaves only 1.214176x, 1.18 percent above the proposed 1.20 gate, before bitmap SRAM ports, control, bank conflicts or physical timing.
p1.impact: The arithmetic supports one more CPU falsification contract, but cannot authorize RTL or a paper speedup.
p1.required_fix: Make the joint 128-bit-ingress plus 15-cycle-group point the primary gate; charge every PIDP-only port/control latency and require ratio-of-sums >=1.20 and every sequence >=1.05.

p1.title: D3 is a real static weight-fit choice but has a hard 13-entry capacity cliff
p1.evidence: All 300 D3 rows use all 13 tile identities. Capacity 16 produces only 3900 cold misses over 285,113,756 references; capacity 12 produces 164,155,303 misses and turns selective performance into 0.573709x. The current 240-KiB proof is logical and fully associative, not macro/port closed.
p1.impact: Any physical organization that exposes fewer than 13 simultaneous weight entries reverses the result.
p1.required_fix: The new contract must freeze a capacity DSE {12,13,16}, require >=13 entries after all metadata/macro rounding, and keep physical/RTL claims false until SRAM ports and mapping close.

p2.title: Acc24 equivalence is scheduling-only
p2.evidence: The independent 288 probes and author 9600 probes use locally quantized M686 FP32 weights; D1 also uses folded-theta diagnostic weights.
p2.required_caveat: No checkpoint quantization, decoder numerical equivalence or accuracy admission follows.

p2.title: Population scope is three selected ten-sample cohorts
p2.required_caveat: Per-sequence stability does not establish population generalization or full-decoder/system speedup.

p2.title: The author handoff alias was resealed during this review
p2.evidence: An earlier observed handoff/manifest/outer tuple f753a113.../0ed506f8.../60a553b4... was replaced by the final pinned tuple b0876d61.../c0e98847.../6167a159... when the 15-cycle sensitivity was added. The canonical M712 result tuple did not change.
p2.required_caveat: Cite the final handoff by SHA tuple, never by mutable directory path alone.

new_selective_cpu_contract_required_gate: Freeze the static four-bit layer policy before any row is read; no sample, sequence, density, miss-rate or runtime selector.
Use the same M699 S3x10 population and fixed A1-OSG denominator with ratio-of-sums; report every sequence separately.
Primary fairness point uses 128-bit A1 ingress and 15 cycles/group for PIDP; the 10-cycle point is optimistic ablation only.
Capacity DSE includes 12, 13 and 16 entries; capacity >=13 after all logical metadata is mandatory.
Charge bitmap SRAM read ports/latency, priority/group formation, control, refill and dense commit without overlap shortcuts.
Any positive result remains CPU diagnostic; fresh result hammer is required before any minimal RTL decision.
No D1 headline, checkpoint numeric claim, system speedup, energy/PPA or paper headline.

admitted: full-PIDP KILL decision within the frozen optimistic CPU coordinate
selective 1.474346x as a non-admitted static composition diagnostic
permission to author a new fail-closed selective CPU contract
not_admitted: RTL, VCS, DC, Formality, STA, power, energy or PPA
full decoder, full network or system speedup
